title: Fixed Trough-Fed Hand Chaff Cutter
description: One complete original fixed-pose trough-fed hand chaff-cutter appearance: four full grounded legs and longitudinal support rails hold one long thick open feed trough, an elevated transverse axle bridge, a separate large open-spoked rim and two broad swept fixed blade silhouettes at the trough mouth, with an outward wooden crank grip. The entire feed trough remains visible behind the cutting-head display. Not a seed-hopper roller, fan-housing winnower, twin abrasive-wheel grinder or piston/crosshead bench. Twenty closed editable meshes and four opaque constant PBR roles; one prop and zero scenes. Static game-art appearance only: no animation, working mechanism, exact blade clearance, feed-through operation, cutting performance, crop processing, engineering, manufacture, use instructions or safety certification.
